Student Magazines

The Harvard Lyceum. (Cambridge, Mass: Hilliard and Metcalf, 1810-1811). (Harvard login required.)  First known Harvard student paper. See additional online content here.

The Harvard Magazine. (Cambridge, Mass: J. Bartlett, 1854-1864). See additional online content here

Harvard Advocate. (Cambridge, MA : Harvard Advocate, 1866-). Some content may be limited to “Search Only.” Recent issues available online via the journal website.

The Harvard Lampoon. (Cambridge, Mass. : Harvard Lampoon, 1876-). See additional online content here. Some content may be limited to “Search Only. Recent issues available online via the journal website.

The Harvard Monthly. (Cambridge, Mass.: Students of Harvard College, 1885-1917, 1937-1938).

The Harvard Illustrated Magazine. (Cambridge, Mass: Harvard Illustrated, 1899-1919).

Student Newspapers

The Harvard Crimson (Cambridge, Mass.: Students of Harvard University, 1873- ).

  • The Magenta (Cambridge, Mass: Students of Harvard University,1873-1875).
  • The Crimson (Cambridge, Mass.: Students of Harvard University, 1875-1883).

Yearbooks

Harvard College Yearbooks

  • The Harvard Portfolio. (Cambridge, Mass: 1890-1897). 1890, 1895.
  • Harvard Class Album. (Cambridge, Mass: 1898-1949). 1913, 1920.
  • The Harvard Freshman Red Book. (Cambridge, Mass.,c1910-1953). 1913-1922.

Student Directories

The Harvard Index / Harvard University register. (1874-1928).  A directory of organizations, athletic events, officers and students.

  • The Harvard index for ... (Cambridge, Mass : Welch, Bigelow : 1874-1898).
  • The Harvard University register.  (Boston, Mass: Alfred Mudge, 1898-1928). Some content may be limited to “Search Only."
